title: rosa canina f. eriostyla
intro: Rosa canina f. eriostyla, commonly known as Dwarf Wild Rose, is a shrub species belonging to the family Rosaceae, characterized by its small size and compact growth habit. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it a potential remedy for various conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Wild Rose are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, which can be beneficial for individuals experiencing anxiety or stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
